items.title: TNT Teens
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Are you ready for these dynamite teens!? I sure hope so because they really pack a punch! If you are like me and love TNT, then this is the skin pack for you! Perfect for all your explosive needs.

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Monsters
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Run for your life!! These monster skins will send anyone into a frozen terror. Best not to let one catch you...

items.title: Golden Teens
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Fashionable rich teens are on the move! Are you a gold loving individual yourself? A person of true taste it seems. Grab the squad, and survive in style as a golden teen! Surviving never looked so good.

items.title: Green & Red
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Two of the best colors, now on skins!

items.title: Rich Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Show off your best with the best attire around.

items.title: Goofy Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: When you are feeling like a teen, but also feeling a little goofy.

items.title: Famers
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Time to lay back on a barrel of hay, put on your best jeans, and farm.

items.title: Picnic Friends
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Picnics are great, but they are even better with friends.

items.title: Neon
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Be the best and brightest around. No other choice than to use neon.

items.title: Rainbow Slimes
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Slimes don't just have to be one color! None of them are bad slimes.

items.title: Thrift Store Attire
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Some of the best deals are also the best looking.

items.title: Island
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome to the lost island, your ship crashed into reefs making you stranded! Wash up ashore and loot chests, explore the island's temples, and build farms. Use your courage and parkour skills to climb the island's peak or crawls into the abandoned mines to find diamonds. How long will you survive stranded on the island?

By honeyfrost

items.title: Fall Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It's that time of year again! Grab your favorite sweater and stylish shoes as you get ready for the beginning of a new season! 

- 10 unique skins for the start of fall
- Perfect for kids and teens
- By Xenon Design

items.title: Anime Summer Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Be your own anime character this summer! Choose your favorite skin from Anime Summer Teens and start a new adventure!

- 10 unique anime skins
- Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Spaceship
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
We've always been wishing upon the stars, so why not be there among them? See the universe and test your luck! Join our fleet of spaceships and we will take you to live among the stars!

- 10 new lucky blocks!
- Over 100 lucky or unlucky events!
- Custom survival skyblock spawn!

items.title: Millionaire Luxury Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Luxury Mansion is everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a private pool, this mansion has tons of stuff for you to explore! Have fun and enjoy all the luxury.

- Modern design
- Great with friends!

items.title: Invisible People
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Who's there!? Show yourself! Sneak up on your friends when they least expect it and give them the fright of their lives with the Invisible People skin pack, where not even the smartest of Creepers can see where you are.

- 10 spooky skins (with one free skin!)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Camo Creepers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Blend in with the creepers with the Camo Creepers skin pack. Fall in lava? It's fine! You're blending in! Find a skeleton? Well, you might have a weird face, but you definitely still look like one! They'll never find you now.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cool Club
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Are you as cool as an ice cube? If so, make sure you match up your look! Join the Cool Club and have your outside match how amazing you are on the inside - no one can deny how ice-cold you are with these looks.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Disguised Animals
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Disguised animals have appeared! Dress up as your favorite animal in disguise.

+ Cute animals in hiding
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Orange and Cream
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Orange and cream! Tasting good! Feeling great! Looking awesome! Catch your new drip in these colors!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and casual attire inspired by orange and cream!

items.title: Lucky Block Heads
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Luck is all in the head! Literally! Feel the power of lucky blocks!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and casual attire inspired by lucky blocks!

items.title: Gachigym
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Strong, pumped up, fit and powerful, these skins are simply forged for sports. Ever wanted to be a huge pile of muscles? Well, then this skin pack is the right choice for you.

+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Elder Evil
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack is made for you to play as monstrous, scariest horrors as you can imagine. Have you ever wanted to spook your friends in-game or roleplay as a monster? Try out this one!

+ Spooky
+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
